    About this reader

    Commentary text is transcribed from scanned volumes of al-Ṭībī, Mirqāt and Lamaʿāt as printed. Footnotes are the printed editors' notes.

    Install on iPhone or iPad

    1. Tap the Share button in Safari’s toolbar.
    2. Choose Add to Home Screen.
    3. Tap Add. The reader then opens full-screen and works without a connection.
